evidence: Carries the 'UTXO Db and Indexes' label and modifies prevout fetching and UTXO view overlays in src/coins.cpp and src/coins.h.
rationale: Reuses heap allocations across blocks and avoids dispatching idle worker threads during parallel prevout fetching. The author claims 'this also results in a 1% validation speedup', making this a worthwhile block-connection optimization though reasonably deferrable without verified benchmarks.
